tools.name: list_tracked_tools
tools.description: Deprecated: use list_tools. All AI coding tools Havoptic tracks (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Kiro CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Devin Desktop/Windsurf, Antigravity CLI, Grok Build), with release counts and their latest release.

tools.name: latest_releases
tools.description: Deprecated: use get_latest_releases. Most recent AI coding tool releases (newest first), optionally filtered to one tool. Returns summaries; use get_release for full notes. Default detail=brief omits infographic URLs.

tools.name: release_history
tools.description: Deprecated: use get_latest_releases with since. Release history for one tool within an optional date window (newest first). Summaries only; use get_release for full notes. Default detail=brief omits infographic URLs.

tools.name: search_release_notes
tools.description: Deprecated: use search_changes. Full-text search across all tracked release notes — flags, error strings, feature names, config keys. Returns ranked matches with snippet context.

tools.name: feature_timeline
tools.description: Deprecated: use feature_adoption. Which tool shipped each notable cross-tool feature first (MCP support, subagents, planning mode, hooks, checkpoints, ...), follower lag in days, and copying-trend insights. Optionally filter to one feature.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Catalog of the products Havoptic tracks (AI coding tools plus model/API platforms, agent SDKs and inference runtimes): id, name, vendor, category, release count and latest release. Use first to find valid tool ids (fuzzy query: 'copilot', 'devin').

tools.name: get_latest_releases
tools.description: Newest releases (newest first) across all or selected tools. Successor to latest_releases and release_history (pass since/until for a date window). Default channel=stable, detail=brief.

tools.name: whats_changed_since
tools.description: Digest of typed changes (breaking, security, features, fixes, …) since a date or relative window ('7d', '30d'), grouped by tool with breaking changes first. States how many releases in range are legacy records without typed changes.

tools.name: search_changes
tools.description: Search typed change items (title + evidence) and, unless kinds is set, legacy release notes — flags, error strings, feature names, config keys. Successor to search_release_notes. Brief mode returns snippets only.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: One release by id (e.g. 'claude-code-2.1.183', canonical 'claude-code@2.1.183') or by tool + version ('latest' allowed). detail=full (the default for a bare id lookup, as before) includes complete release notes; brief/standard omit them unless include_raw_notes is true.

tools.name: get_upgrade_notes
tools.description: Everything between two versions of one tool: breaking changes, deprecations, security fixes, features and fixes, plus an explicit coverage gap for legacy releases without typed changes. to_version defaults to latest.

tools.name: get_breaking_changes
tools.description: Breaking changes (and, by default, deprecations) across tools in a window (default last 30 days), newest first. Legacy releases without typed changes are counted, not guessed.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare 2–4 AI coding tools: release cadence, feature-matrix differences, recent changes, and Havoptic's editorial verdict per pair. aspects defaults to cadence, features, verdict. Legacy inputs tool_a/tool_b still work.

tools.name: feature_adoption
tools.description: Who shipped a cross-tool feature first (MCP support, subagents, planning mode, hooks, checkpoints, …), which tools followed and their lag in days. Successor to feature_timeline.

tools.name: cadence_stats
tools.description: How fast tools ship: release counts over 7/30/90 days, average days between releases, and last release — for selected tools or all of them. Legacy input tool (single id) still works.
